title: Groceries

description:
🧂 Ingredients

  1. 2 whole pork tenderloins (~2–2.5 lbs total)
  2. 1 onion, sliced
  3. 3 cloves garlic, minced
  4. 1 bell pepper, sliced (optional)
  5. 2 tbsp brown sugar
  6. 2 tbsp soy sauce
  7. 1 tbsp teriyaki sauce (optional)
  8. 1 tsp smoked paprika
  9. 1/2 tsp cumin
  10. 1/2 tsp chili powder (optional)
  11. 1/4 tsp black pepper
  12. 1/2 tsp salt
  13. 3/4 cup water (or broth)
  14. 1 tbsp oil (for searing)

🔥 Instructions

  1. Sear (recommended):
  2. Pat pork dry and season lightly with salt and pepper.
  3. Heat skillet with 1 tbsp oil over medium-high.
  4. Sear both whole tenderloins until browned on all sides (about 2–3 min per side).
  5. Transfer to Instant Pot.
  6. Prepare Instant Pot:
  7. Layer onions, bell pepper, and garlic on the bottom.
  8. Lay the whole tenderloins on top.
  9. Sprinkle on brown sugar, paprika, cumin, chili powder.
  10. Pour soy sauce, teriyaki, and water (or broth) over everything.
  11. Cook:
  12. Seal lid.
  13. Set to Manual / Pressure Cook – 50 minutes.
  14. Natural release for 10–15 minutes, then quick release.
  15. Shred:
  16. Remove pork to a plate. It should shred easily with forks.
  17. Optional: use Sauté mode to reduce the cooking liquid for a thicker sauce.
  18. Finish:
  19. Return shredded pork to sauce.
  20. Taste and adjust salt or sweetness if needed.
title: 🍖 Whole Pork Tenderloin Pulled Pork – Instant Pot

description:
Oven-Baked Baby Back Ribs

Ingredients:

  1. 1 rack of baby back ribs
  2. 1/4 cup brown sugar
  3. 1 tablespoon paprika
  4. 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  5. 1 teaspoon onion powder
  6. 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
  7. 1/2 teaspoon salt
  8. 1/2 teaspoon chili powder (optional for a bit of heat)
  9. 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional for extra heat)
  10. 1/2 cup BBQ sauce (plus more for serving)
  11. 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar or apple juice (optional for extra moisture)

Instructions:

  1. Prepare the Ribs:
  2. Preheat your oven to 275°F (135°C).
  3. Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs by using a knife to lift it at one end and then pulling it off with your fingers or a paper towel.
  4. Seasoning:
  5. In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, salt, chili powder, and cayenne pepper.
  6. Rub the spice mixture all over both sides of the ribs, ensuring they are well-coated.
  7. Wrapping the Ribs:
  8. Place the ribs on a large piece of aluminum foil (enough to wrap the ribs completely).
  9. Pour the apple cider vinegar or apple juice around the ribs (optional for added moisture).
  10. Wrap the ribs tightly in the foil, sealing the edges well to create a packet.
  11. Cooking:
  12. Place the wrapped ribs on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 3 to 4 hours, or until the ribs are tender and easily pull apart with a fork.
  13. Finishing the Ribs:
  14. Carefully remove the ribs from the oven and increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C).
  15. Open the foil packet and brush the ribs with BBQ sauce on both sides.
  16. Place the ribs back on the baking sheet, uncovered, and return them to the oven.
  17. Bake for an additional 10 to 15 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized and sticky.
title: Oven-Baked Baby Back Ribs

description:
Let's get a web-based two-player live-drawing pictionary-type game. This will be hosted at drawit.blahpunk.com and I'll have the files in /var/www/drawit.blahpunk.com.


Matches will work in a round-robin style. When a user visits the page they get a lobby menu listing the current rooms and how many players with the total number of player slots available per room. Users can join a room or create a new room -- rooms disappear when they are empty. Choosing to join a room lets you chose how many players between 2 and 9 and allows setting a 4 numeric digit room code used to access the room, which is empty by default and if not set then anyone can join without a code. If a code has been set for a room then show a lock icon next to those rooms in the room lobby.
